entries.test: Contemporaneous reporting, Barrett's ChatGPT transcript, and documentation of the underlying model's ability to access external news without tools would settle the claim.
entries.note: The capability claim concerns the underlying model acting on its own.

entries.test: Publication timestamps of accurate reporting and Barrett's timestamped Perplexity exchange would establish whether reporting preceded its erroneous response and attribution to user misinformation.
Public evaluations of pure models on post-training facts, novel reasoning tasks, and unaided web access would test the asserted limitations.
entries.note: Marcus is quoting his own endorsed statement; attribution remains his.
The central commitment is a recommendation about business trust.

entries.test: Public staffing records, timestamped ChatGPT responses, and OpenAI's incident or change records would establish staffing scale and whether the apparent correction reflected a patch.
entries.note: A couple of hours later dates his experiments, rather than establishing the patch's turnaround time. The proposition also drops the limitation to his brief experiments.

entries.test: Public controlled studies of breaking-news errors and hallucinations, including interventions on models' world representations, would test the proposed shared mechanism.
entries.note: Difficulty establishing the mechanism does not make the causal claim uncheckable.

entries.test: Public system architectures and evaluations separating base-model capabilities from added components would test whether additional capabilities come from external layers with variable reliability.
entries.note: The colloquial wording has a concrete architectural reading in context.

entries.test: Public audits, disclosures, and longitudinal evaluations would test whether companies continue relying on substantial human correction and undisclosed patches or decisively escape that cycle.
entries.note: The repeated 'forever' and 'endlessly' extend the claim into the indefinite future.
The proposition strengthens unreliability into inability. 'Matter most' supplies no shared measure for comparing military planning with other domains.

entries.test: Public evidence that either the United States or China achieved complete dominance of generative AI would refute the categorical exclusion of that outcome.
entries.note: Despite the sarcastic phrasing, he commits to neither side completely dominating. 'Any chance' is negated, making this a firm exclusion rather than a hedged possibility.
He calls a tie far more likely; he does not firmly predict it.
The preceding sentence supplies the acceptance of brainstorming and coding. Calling military strategy use laughable expresses a judgment against that use.

The conclusion evaluates reliance on these systems as military strategy. The proposition turns 'hardly the way' into a categorical exclusion and omits the qualification about access to human correction.
